observations.cosmic_density: The first two panels carry the layered v09 web. The new footer uses crisply resolved cyan and ember filaments and fine grains near the edges.
observations.dark_voids: The closing artwork has an open dark type bed; the strands feather into the GitHub dark canvas at the perimeter.
observations.luminous_clusters: Small ice-blue and ember knots form in the sides of the closing artwork. The brightest region at center is the invitation text.
observations.vertical_continuity: The banner and two text transitions carry the v09 blue and orange web. The final panel echoes their descending motion along both margins.
observations.phone_legibility: The two invitations remain legible at 255 px in the decoded GIF and its PNG still. The text does not move.
observations.fibonacci_structure: Earlier panels retain 21 frames at 130 ms. The Nexus runs at 34 frames and 80 ms with the golden ratio setting the slope and phase separation.
observations.handoff_ontology: The cyan lane carries the invitation to explore and the ember lane carries the invitation to collaborate. The linked graphic opens the public work.
observations.continuous_motion: Both outer sides drift through a seamless, infinite 2.72-second loop. The static poster shows the same two invitations.
observations.palette: Cold blue and ember match the avatar and upper panels. Off-white and warm white set two distinct lines of stable text.
observations.pinned_handoff: The closing graphic occupies the former blank sides. Its glints drift down on both margins toward Pinned. The image is the final visible README content.
